text:
jamie: CI alert — main is red after merge (PR #1976 by @trung). Failing job: beam-inference-e2e (node-3). Link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4130001234 :link:
ci-bot: Build 4130001234 failed on step 'beam-inference-e2e' — exit code 134. Artifacts: s3://ci-artifacts/4130001234/beam.log
lee: :eyes: who owns that test?
trung: that was my PR (1976), but it was just scheduling tweaks, didn't touch model code. I'll look.
sophia: error looks like SIGABRT in libtorch (see snippet). Can someone paste the top of beam.log?
jamie: ```[2026-03-18 14:02:11] [ERROR] runtime: signal SIGABRT (6) at 0x7f...
  #0 0x7f9a2d3a1bcd in raise
  #1 0x7f9a2d39d8f1 in abort
  #2 0x7f9b1c2a4e8f in torch::autograd::GraphExecutor::execute
  Aborted (core dumped)
```
maria-oncall: can we rerun the job first? usually flake. If it fails again we bisect commit range since last green (main at 4129990000).
lee: rerun started by @maria-oncall — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4130001235
ci-bot: Rerun 4130001235 completed — beam-inference-e2e failed again, same exit code 134.
trung: OK, I'll bisect locally. Are there any recent libtorch/version bumps on main?
sophia: There was a runtime libs bump landed yesterday — commit 4129987766 updated native libs. Could be related.
jamie: If you need quick mitigation, we can pin to previous runtime build in Dedicated, but prefer bisect first. @maria-oncall can you block merges for a bit?
maria-oncall: putting a temporary hold label on merges and notifying release leads.
trung: I'll start `git bisect` across 4129985000..4130001234 and report back.
lee: If bisect points to the lib change, we should revert the runtime bump and redeploy. If it's our change, open hotfix PR.
trung: quick update — first suspect: commit 4129987766 (runtime: bump libtorch). Reproduces locally for me (no ASAN) when running beam-inference-e2e with `--batch=8`.
sophia: Confirmed on my laptop too. Reproduces with `--batch=8` and `--num-workers=2`. Looks like memory corruption inside libtorch native ops.
jamie: Thanks team. I'll draft a rollback PR for the runtime bump while @trung continues bisect + logs. Keep updates here.
trung: filing bisect result + logs in a draft PR, will link in ~15m.
